name: ABSD Under Maintenance
author: absdhiten

sections.description:
ABSD Under Maintenance lets you put your WordPress site into a clean, professional maintenance / coming-soon screen in seconds — no page builder required.

Features

  • ON/OFF maintenance mode toggle
  • 6 professionally designed, fully responsive templates
  • Logo & background image upload via the Media Library
  • Adjustable overlay darkness and accent color
  • Editable heading, description, small text, footer/copyright text, and retry text
  • Optional icon and optional contact information
  • Private access: a secure, unpredictable link that lets specific visitors bypass maintenance mode without logging in, with regenerate/revoke controls
  • Administrators stay logged in and see the site normally while maintenance mode is active
  • Returns a proper HTTP 503 status with a Retry-After header, which is the recommended approach for temporary downtime
  • Login, admin, REST API, AJAX and cron requests are never blocked, so nothing else on your site breaks while maintenance mode is on
  • Translation-ready
  • No tracking, no external service calls, no bundled third-party frameworks
sections.installation:
1. Upload the absd-under-maintenance folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Under Maintenance in the admin menu to configure.
  4. Choose a template, fill in your text, optionally add a logo/background image, then toggle Maintenance Mode on and save.
sections.faq:
Will administrators be locked out of the site?

No. Logged-in users with the manage_options capability (administrators) always see the normal site, even while maintenance mode is active.

Will this break my login page, REST API, or cron jobs?

No. The maintenance screen is never shown for wp-login.php, wp-admin, the REST API, AJAX requests, or WP-Cron, so core WordPress functionality keeps working normally.

Can I let specific people preview the site while maintenance mode is on?

Yes. Enable “Private Access” in the settings to generate a secret, unpredictable link. Anyone who opens that link gets a signed cookie that lets them browse the whole site normally for 12 hours. You can regenerate or revoke the link at any time from the settings page.

Does this plugin send any data externally?

No. The plugin does not make any external HTTP requests, load any remote resources, or collect/transmit any data.
